content.text: {"Id":"BUG-TRIAGE-115","Title":"sessionlog_query fails: SessionLogs missing Agent* columns","Section":"Backlog","Priority":"high","Done":false,"Estimate":null,"Note":null,"Description":["sessionlog_query fails on every call with SQL Server-style Invalid column name for AgentExecutablePath, AgentExecutableVersion, AgentSessionId, and AgentSessionTranscriptFile. Code and EF model already define these on SessionLogEntity (and client/DTO/workflow layers). Migration 20260722214500_AddAgentSessionHeaderFields adds the four nullable columns to SessionLogs, and McpDbContextModelSnapshot includes them. The failure is runtime schema drift: the live database for the queried workspace has not received that migration, so SELECTs generated by EF reference columns that do not exist. Host startup applies migrations via McpDatabaseMigrationCoordinator.ApplyMigrationsAsync; remediation is apply that migration (or restart/redeploy so it runs) and confirm SessionLogs has the four columns before treating query code as broken.","Triage group: triage-group-be979efad9c79409","Reports: 1"],"TechnicalDetails":["Acceptance criteria:","- sessionlog_query against a workspace DB returns 200 with results (or empty list) without Invalid column name errors for AgentExecutablePath, AgentExecutableVersion, AgentSessionId, or AgentSessionTranscriptFile","- SessionLogs table in the affected database includes nullable columns AgentSessionId, AgentSessionTranscriptFile, AgentExecutablePath, and AgentExecutableVersion matching migration 20260722214500_AddAgentSessionHeaderFields","- After migration, sessionlog_query with limit 1 and with a text filter both succeed without SQL schema errors","Implementation notes:","- Do not change query/DTO mapping first: entity, snapshot, and migration already agree; missing DB columns are the defect surface","- Confirm migration 20260722214500_AddAgentSessionHeaderFields is present in __EFMigrationsHistory for each affected workspace/provider database; apply pending migrations if not","- Host already calls McpDatabaseMigrationCoordinator.ApplyMigrationsAsync from Program.cs and McpStdioHost; verify the running process is a build that includes this migration and that workspace DBs are on that migration path","- Error text Invalid column name is typical of SQL Server; validate provider-specific migration application if the workspace is not SQLite","- Optional hardening: fail fast at startup with a clear pending-migration error if SessionLogs lacks expected columns, instead of surfacing raw SQL on every sessionlog_query"],"ImplementationTasks":null,"CompletedDate":null,"DoneSummary":null,"Remaining":null,"PriorityNote":null,"Reference":null,"Phase":null,"DependsOn":null,"FunctionalRequirements":["FR-MCP-TRIAGE-002"],"TechnicalRequirements":["TR-MCP-TRIAGE-004"],"IdempotencyKey":null}
